item.title: Local TD repeats calls for implementation of Portiuncula reports
item.description: A local TD has repeated calls for the implementation of two reports into maternity services at Portiuncula University Hospital. Fianna Fáil TD Martin Daly made the call following confirmation that there are five reviews currently ongoing into the care of women and their babies at the hospital. The Head of the HSE Bernard Gloster told an Oireachtas Committee these are expected to be completed before the end of March. Seven reviews have been completed and the recommendations shared with families.

item.title: Plans to develop new men's shed in south Roscommon in 2026
item.description: Around 40 people attended a meeting in Roscommon last night to discuss the establishment of a men's shed. There are plans to set up a new shed at St Brigid's GAA Club in Kiltoom aimed at men across the south of the county. The men’s shed movement was first founded in Australia in the 1980’s, and has since expanded to other countries. item.title: Increase in flu outbreaks on wards in Sligo University Hospital
item.description: Sligo University Hospital has reiterated its plea to people with flu-like symptoms not to visit the hospital. The facility previously made an appeal last week as flu cases continue to rise sharply in the community. Six flu outbreaks have now been confirmed on separate wards, an increase on five outlined last week. 23 patients with flu are being treated at Sligo University Hospital with a number of older people presenting to the emergency department with symptoms.
